messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a plan for splitting console query lanes to hit SLOs without regressing RBAC checks. Proposal: fast-path (local ticket verification + cache) + slow-path (full auth-service lookup). Thoughts?

aj: can we avoid an auth shadow call on fast-path? that's the big perf hit.

zhou: i'd prefer prefix-caching with signed tickets. Fast-path verifies ticket locally, slow-path hits auth-service. Ticket TTL ~60s?

sam: risk: tickets mean we need revocation for permission changes. How do we evict?

maria: two options: short TTL (~30s) or revocation stream from auth to query-layer. short TTL simpler to start.

elaine: product note — some customers require instant permission changes. When would they see a change with short TTL?

maria: with 30s TTL worst-case ~30s window; we can add an explicit mode for customers that require immediate enforcement where requests always go slow-path.

aj: performance tradeoff numbers: current median p95 request latency ~85ms. Fast-path target p95 ~50ms. An external auth call adds ~40–60ms on average.

zhou: suggest rolling canary: 5% traffic to fast-path, monitor for 24h, then 25% while checking mismatch rates. Need shadow logs for auth mismatches.

sam: also watch cache churn: many tenants + short TTL => thrash. Consider per-tenant cache sizing and token-bucket admission for fast-path.

maria: filing rollup checklist:
```
- feature flag: query_lane_split
- canary stages: 5% -> 25% -> 50%
- metrics: p50/p95 latency, auth-mismatch-rate, revocation-failures, cache-hit-rate
- automated fallback: disable fast-path if auth-mismatch > 0.5% over 15m
- infra: revocation stream opt-in and safety valve for instant-enforce tenants
```

infra-bot: deploy plan created: https://deploys/redwood/console/query-lane-split/4521 (rollout window 02:00-06:00 UTC)

zhou: SGTM. i'll PR the ticket-signing code + config draft (will include sample policy + TTL knobs).

aj: i'll add dashboards and alerts for auth-mismatch and tenant cache hit-rate; also add a synthetic test hitting both paths.

elaine: ok from product — make sure docs call out the revocation window, and add a migration path for tenants that need instant enforcement. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. i'll send meeting invite for 15m tomorrow to unblock the PRs and align rollout owners.
